script: The Hubble Space Telescope launched in 1990. At first its pictures were blurry because its main mirror had a tiny flaw. In 1993, astronauts flew up and fixed it with corrective optics, like glasses. Hubble has helped show that the universe's expansion is speeding up. It has been working for more than 35 years.
